presets.title: Presets
presets.welcomeHint: Simulate light from a source to a detector with blocks. Start from a preset, or take the guided tour.
presets.orBuild: …or build your own: drag elements from the palette on the left.

welcome.title: Welcome to LUMOS
welcome.text: LUMOS simulates how light travels through an instrument: from a source, through optical elements, to a detector. We have opened a first simulation for you.

palette.title: The elements
palette.text: Every element of the library is here, by category: sources, telescopes, optics, detectors, processing… Drag one onto the canvas, or click it.

canvas.title: The optical system
canvas.text: Blocks are connected by wires: light flows from left to right. Drag from an output (right of a block) to an input (left) to connect; the colour of a port tells the kind of light it carries.

block.title: A block
block.text: Each block shows its name, its type and a few values. Click it to select it.

inspector.title: Its parameters
inspector.text: The inspector shows the parameters of the selected block, with their units: type a value (e.g. 3 mm) and press Enter. Ctrl+Z undoes any change.

run.title: Run the simulation
run.text: Run computes the outputs of the context. Press Next: we run it for you (Ctrl+Enter does it too).

results.title: The results
results.text: Each output appears with its figure and its statistics, with units. Download the figure, the data or the whole signal.

inspect.title: Look anywhere
inspect.text: Click the name of any output of a block to see the light at that point, without running everything.

files.title: Keep your work
files.text: Save the context as a .lumos file, open one, or get the equivalent Python script.

help.title: Help
help.text: Replay this tour at any time, and press ? for the keyboard shortcuts.

done.title: Your turn!
done.text: Change a value and run again, or open another preset. The documentation explains the physics of every element.

operation.disabled: The operation of equipment is disabled on this instance: actions only change the simulation (digital twin).
operation.operatorOnly: Only operators drive equipment: log in as an operator.
operation.addresses: Addresses of the devices (one per line)
operation.noAction: No element of this context has actions.
operation.stopHint: Emergency stop of every device of the context
operation.confirmText: {{action}} will drive the device {{device}}. Check that the bench is safe.
